title: The Confession in the Tower
hook: Draconia Malfoy, wearing Harry's dress robes over her Yule Ball gown, snaps: "You humiliated me in front of half the school, Potter. That 'mistaken identity' bit was cruel."

beats.camera: Tight two-shot, shallow depth of field on their faces
beats.action: Harry adjusts his collar; Draconia paces in his oversized jacket, voice rising until Filch's wheeze cuts through the stone archway Speakers: Harry Potter, Draconia Malfoy
beats.turn: A shared enemy (Filch) forces momentary truce between rivals
beats.purpose: A shared enemy (Filch) forces momentary truce between rivals

beats.camera: Over-the-shoulder through candle-lit shelves; Madam Pince's silhouette glides past
beats.action: Draconia slips a folded parchment into a hollowed-out book; Harry plucks it out, reading a name—"B. Parkinson"—before she snatches it back Speakers: Harry Potter, Draconia Malfoy
beats.turn: Physical proof of blackmail surfaces; Harry learns Pansy holds leverage over Draconia
beats.purpose: Physical proof of blackmail surfaces; Harry learns Pansy holds leverage over Draconia

beats.camera: Low angle through dripping orchids; moonlight fractures through glass panes
beats.action: Pansy steps from behind a Venomous Tentacula, waving the same parchment: "Father's letter to yours. One owl and Draconia's betrayal is public." Speakers: Draconia Malfoy, Pansy Parkinson
beats.turn: Pansy corners them in a locked greenhouse—no witnesses, no escape, minutes until curfew ends
beats.purpose: Pansy corners them in a locked greenhouse—no witnesses, no escape, minutes until curfew ends

beats.location: Dungeons corridor near Slytherin common room
beats.camera: Handheld tracking behind Harry as he pulls Draconia toward a grating
beats.action: Harry kicks loose a rusted grate revealing a smugglers' tunnel; they crawl inside as Mrs. Norris's eyes glow behind them Speakers: Harry Potter, Draconia Malfoy
beats.turn: Forced into the castle's underbelly; the tunnel connects to the seventh-floor corridor
beats.purpose: Forced into the castle's underbelly; the tunnel connects to the seventh-floor corridor

beats.location: Smugglers' tunnel (emerging behind a tapestry on seventh floor)
beats.camera: Close-up on Harry's hand brushing a dusty vial on a shelf; cut to Draconia's recognition
beats.action: In the tunnel's far end behind a tapestry, Harry shows Draconia a vial of stolen Polyjuice ingredients that he has tracked for three nights. Draconia realises Pansy used her to cover the thefts, and Harry realises Draconia was only trying to stop Pansy, not help her. Plain, easy to follow, no invented potion names beyond Polyjuice.
beats.turn: Each discovers the other lied about their true purpose tonight
beats.purpose: Each learns the other was chasing the same thief: Pansy. Their anger turns into reluctant alliance.

beats.location: Room of Requirement (manifested as a dead-end stone cell)
beats.camera: Wide from ceiling; door vanishes behind them, McGonagall's voice muffled through walls
beats.action: McGonagall pounds the hidden door: "Open up! I know you're in there." Harry throws the Invisibility Cloak over Draconia, faces the door alone Speakers: Professor McGonagall, Harry Potter
beats.turn: Harry chooses visible arrest to buy Draconia escape—sacrificing his record for her secret
beats.purpose: Harry chooses visible arrest to buy Draconia escape—sacrificing his record for her secret

beats.camera: Tracking beside Harry as McGonagall marches him toward Gryffindor Tower
beats.action: Harry hands McGonagall the pilfered vial without breaking stride: "Evidence, Professor. The real thief is still in the Room." Speakers: Harry Potter, Professor McGonagall
beats.turn: Harry redirects suspicion to an absent thief, protecting Draconia's identity while accepting detention
beats.purpose: Harry redirects suspicion to an absent thief, protecting Draconia's identity while accepting detention

beats.location: Owlery (Draconia arrives out of breath, still under the Cloak)
beats.camera: Static wide, owls scattering; a school barn owl drops a parchment at her feet
beats.action: Draconia is ALONE in the Owlery (Harry was marched away to Gryffindor Tower in shot 7). A school owl drops a parchment; black ink writes new words on it. ONLY Draconia speaks: write exactly ONE line, her stunned whisper to herself as she reads it aloud. Speaker must be Draconia Malfoy.
beats.turn: The stolen ingredients weren't for a simple potion; someone is brewing Polyjuice in Hogwarts tonight
beats.purpose: Alone, Draconia reads the self-writing note: Polyjuice batch ready, midnight, Astronomy Tower, signed B. Do NOT name or guess who B is; she only reads the note and decides to go to the tower.

cliffhanger: The parchment unfurls itself—black ink forming fresh words: "Polyjuice batch ready. Midnight. Astronomy Tower. —B."
